programme.title: Yesterday we were still children / Gestern waren wir noch Kinder
programme.desc: The successful lawyer Peter lives with his wife Anna and his three children in a suburb of Munch. Family life seems perfect, but on Anna's birthday Peter is dead. programme.title: Blue Bloods - Crime Scene New York / Blue Bloods - Crime Scene New York
programme.desc: Frank Reagan is head of the New York police. The widower thus follows his father, who also led this behavior and who is always helpful to him with his knowledge and contacts. The fight against the crime for the Reagan is not a mere job, but a real family matter. Because Frank's son Daniel and Jamison are already tastes of the typical blue police uniforms. / Frank Reagan ist Chef der Polizei von New York. Der Witwer folgt damit seinem Vater, der diese Behorde fruher ebenfalls leitete und der ihm mit seinem Wissen und seinen Kontakten immer wieder hilfreich zur Seite steht. Der Kampf gegen das Verbrechen ist fur die Reagans also kein bloSSer Job, sondern eine regelrechte Familienangelegenheit. Denn auch Franks Sohne Daniel und Jamison sind schon Trager der typischen blauen Polizeiuniformen.

programme.title: Good Trouble / Good Trouble
programme.desc: Callie and Mariana experience their subsequent adventure in their life in Los Angeles. programme.title: All American / All American
programme.desc: Two contradictory worlds collapse when the football talent Spencer from the hard Compton district is recruited by a trainer from Beverly Hills. Spencer faces the challenge of finding his way around in his new environment. / Zwei gegensatzliche Welten prallen aufeinander, als das Footballtalent Spencer aus dem harten Stadtteil Compton von einem Trainer aus Beverly Hills angeworben wird. programme.title: S.W.A.T. / S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: After a mistake by his boss, Daniel Harrelson becomes head of the S.W.A.T. team in Los Angeles. He and his team cattle against drug dealers, terrorists and gangs and are always called when all other vingers no longer know any further knowledge. / Daniel Harrelson wird nach einem Fehler seines Bosses Leiter des S.W.A.T.-Teams in Los Angeles. Er und sein Team kampfen gegen Drogendealer, Terroristen und Gangs und werden immer dann gerufen, wenn alle anderen Behorden nicht mehr weiterwissen.

programme.title: Death in Paradise / Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A cruel violent crime is done on the Caribbean island of Sainte-Marie. In order to clear it up, the London investigator Richard Poole is put on the case. The new environment is actually fantastic, but at all it cannot make friends with the Caribbean mentality. This always ensures entertaining situations. The meticulous suit runner succeeds in loosening the case together with his colleagues on site. They absolutely want to keep him in the Caribbean. He doesn't even like the sea fruit. / Auf der Karibikinsel Sainte-Marie geschieht ein grausames Gewaltverbrechen. Um es aufzuklaren, wird der Londoner Ermittler Richard Poole auf den Fall angesetzt. Die neue Umgebung ist eigentlich traumhaft, doch er kann sich uberhaupt nicht mit der karibischen Mentalitat anfreunden. Das sorgt immer wieder fur unterhaltsame Situationen. Dem peniblen Anzugtrager gelingt es, den Fall gemeinsam mit den Kollegen vor Ort zu losen. Die wollen ihn unbedingt in der Karibik behalten. Dabei mag er nicht einmal Meeresfruchte.

programme.title: Football - World Cup qualifications / Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - World Cup qualifications / Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Made in Italy - Champions of Italy / Made in Italy - Champions of Italy
programme.desc: The largest League competition in Italy was founded in 1898. Twenty clubs are struggled every year for the prestigious title of Champions series A. / Najveće ligaško takmičenje u Italiji osnovano je 1898 godine. Dvadeset klubova se svake godine bori za prestižnu titulu prvaka Serije A.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Qualifications for SP (South America) / Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za SP (Južna Amerika)
programme.desc: Follow the qualifications and find out which of South American teams will succeed in election participation in the World Football Championship. / Pratite kvalifikacije i saznajte koja će od južnoameričkih momčadi uspjeti da izbori učešće na Svjetskom fudbalskom prvenstvu.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - World Cup qualifications / Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - Qualifications for SP (South America) / Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za SP (Južna Amerika)
programme.desc: Follow the qualifications and find out which of South American teams will succeed in election participation in the World Football Championship. / Pratite kvalifikacije i saznajte koja će od južnoameričkih momčadi uspjeti da izbori učešće na Svjetskom fudbalskom prvenstvu.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - World Cup qualifications / Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - World Cup qualifications / Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: A better life / Един по-добър живот
programme.desc: Yang is a cook in a student chair, but dreams of a wider field. He falls in love with Nasya, a waitress in a restaurant who has a girl. The three go on a trip and see an abandoned house that is being sold and deciding to make a restaurant. They take a loan for this purpose, but since they have no money to start, they take revolving loans. The renovation of the room swallow all their money, all requirements are not met and they cannot open the restaurant. Yang and Nadia are separated, and their debt is being paid. Nadia goes to Canada, received a good offer and leaves Sliman to Yang. Initially, Nadia called often, then only with letters. Yang decides to rent the room to pay off the debt. The school understands that Sliman does not live with his parents and report to social. Yang robs the man who lied to him to sell him the restaurant for a little money, and he and Sliman go to Canada to look for Nadia… / Ян е готвач в ученически стол, но мечтае за по-широко поприще. Той се влюбва в Нася, сервитьорка в рестарант, която има момиченце. Тримата излизат на екскурзия и виждат изоставена къща, която се продава и решават да направят ресторант. За целта вземат кредит, но тъй като нямат никакви пари за начало вземат револвиращи кредити. Ремонтът на помещението гълта всичките им пари, всички изисквания не са изпълнени и те не могат да отворят ресторанта. Ян и Надя се разделят, непосилно им е изплащането на дълговете. Надя заминава за Канада, получила е добра оферта и оставя Слиман на Ян. Първоначално Надя се обажда често, после само с писма. Ян решава да даде помещението под наем, за да изплаща дълга. От училището разбират, че Слиман не живее с родителите си и съобщават на социалните. Ян обира мъжа, който го е излъгал да му продаде ресторанта за малко пари и двамата със Слиман заминават за Канада да търсят Надя…

programme.title: A better life / Един по-добър живот
programme.desc: Yang is a cook in a student chair, but dreams of a wider field. He falls in love with Nasya, a waitress in a restaurant who has a girl. The three go on a trip and see an abandoned house that is being sold and deciding to make a restaurant. They take a loan for this purpose, but since they have no money to start, they take revolving loans. The renovation of the room swallow all their money, all requirements are not met and they cannot open the restaurant. Yang and Nadia are separated, and their debt is being paid. Nadia goes to Canada, received a good offer and leaves Sliman to Yang. Initially, Nadia called often, then only with letters. Yang decides to rent the room to pay off the debt. The school understands that Sliman does not live with his parents and report to social. Yang robs the man who lied to him to sell him the restaurant for a little money, and he and Sliman go to Canada to look for Nadia… / Ян е готвач в ученически стол, но мечтае за по-широко поприще. Той се влюбва в Нася, сервитьорка в рестарант, която има момиченце. Тримата излизат на екскурзия и виждат изоставена къща, която се продава и решават да направят ресторант. За целта вземат кредит, но тъй като нямат никакви пари за начало вземат револвиращи кредити. Ремонтът на помещението гълта всичките им пари, всички изисквания не са изпълнени и те не могат да отворят ресторанта. Ян и Надя се разделят, непосилно им е изплащането на дълговете. Надя заминава за Канада, получила е добра оферта и оставя Слиман на Ян. Първоначално Надя се обажда често, после само с писма. Ян решава да даде помещението под наем, за да изплаща дълга. От училището разбират, че Слиман не живее с родителите си и съобщават на социалните. Ян обира мъжа, който го е излъгал да му продаде ресторанта за малко пари и двамата със Слиман заминават за Канада да търсят Надя…

programme.title: Nogomet - Italian Cup / Nogomet - Coppa Italia

programme.title: Philadelphia - Dallas, NFL / Philadelphia - Dallas, NFL
programme.desc: American Football: NFL - (Sport. Program, USA, 2025) NFL season 2025. The final is held in February 2025, with Super Bowl at the Allegiant Stadium Stadium in Las Vegas, Nevada ... / American Football: NFL - (sport. program, SAD, 2025) NFL sezona 2025. predstavlja 106. izdanje Nacionalne nogometne lige, koja započinje 4. rujna 2025. i traje do siječnja 2026. Sudjeluje 32 momčadi s rasporedom od 17 utakmica kroz 18 tjedana. Završnica se održava u veljači 2025., s Super Bowlom na stadionu Allegiant Stadium u Las Vegasu, Nevada...

programme.title: Dynamo - Milan, Football, Champions League / Dinamo - Milan, Nogomet, Liga prvaka
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League - (Sport. Program, 2025) 71. The Champions League season begins with qualifying in July 2025 and ends with a spectacular finals to be held on May 30, 2026 in Budapest. Europe's largest club competition brings together 36 top clubs competing through eight rounds, and only the best go on. Follow the tense matches and enjoy top football! ... / UEFA Champions League - (sport. program, 2025) 71. sezona Lige prvaka počinje kvalifikacijama u srpnju 2025. godine i završava spektakularnim finalom koje će se održati 30. svibnja 2026. u Budimpešti. Najveće europsko klupsko natjecanje okuplja 36 vrhunskih klubova koji se natječu kroz osam kola, a samo oni najbolji idu dalje. Pratite napete utakmice i uživajte u vrhunskom nogometu!...

programme.title: Gyor - Esbjerg, Rucomet, LP / Gyor - Esbjerg, Rukomet, LP
programme.desc: Womens EHF Champions League - (Sport. Program) Season 2024/2025 Champions League brings a new opportunity to top handball clubs to show their quality and fight for the prestigious title of Europe champions. Among the main favorites and this year there are clubs such as Vipers Kristiansand, Győri Audi ETO KC, CSM Bucureşti and Team Esbjerg. The season begins with a group phase, in which teams from all over Europe will fight for placement in further phases. They expect us tactical matches filled with interesting individual duels, but also complex team games that will decide passengers towards the final final4 tournament ... / Womens EHF Champions League - (sport. program) Sezona 2024/2025 Lige prvakinja donosi novu priliku vrhunskim rukometnim klubovima da pokažu svoju kvalitetu i bore se za prestižni naslov prvakinja Europe. Među glavnim favoritima i ove godine nalaze se klubovi poput Vipers Kristiansand, Győri Audi ETO KC, CSM București i Team Esbjerg. Sezona započinje grupnom fazom, u kojoj će se ekipe iz cijele Europe boriti za plasman u daljnje faze. Očekuju nas taktičke utakmice ispunjene zanimljivim pojedinačnim duelima, ali i složenim timskim igrama koje će odlučiti putnike prema završnom FINAL4 turniru...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.desc: Football: Club Friendly - (Sport. Program, 2025) club seasons in most of the world leagues are divided by two parts, autumn and spring. At the time of summer and winter, the clubs are in the preparatory period and complement the difficult rhythm of training by playing preparatory friendly matches. Friendly meetings are a great way to test the current team of teams and temptation of different tactical variants for the upcoming official matches. In friendly meetings, the emphasis is on Fair Play and coaches are allowed to make an unlimited number of changes ... / Football: Club Friendly - (sport. program, 2025) Klupske sezone u većini svjetskih liga podijeljene su dva dijela, jesenski i proljetni. Prijateljski susreti odličan su način za ispitivanje trenutne snage momčadi i iskušavanje različitih taktičkih varijanti za nadolazeće službene utakmice. Također, prilika su za mlađe neafirmirane igrače iz drugog plana za nametnuti se stručnom kadru. U prijateljskim susretima naglasak je na fair playu te je trenerima dozvoljeno napraviti neograničeni broj izmjena...

programme.title: Inas night / Inas Nacht
programme.desc: The late night show with the entertainer, singer and moderator Ina Muller, according to Mullerin Art: Talk, Comedy and a lot of music in the Hamburg pub to the Schellfischposten. In this program, Ina Muller first welcomed the actress and author Andrea Sawatzki. She paid for her unusual childhood, the jobs with which she kept up with her, and get to know her today's husband Christian Berkel. The illusion artists report how their little ones start one of the greatest magic shows in the world, which are now also touring the USA. And of course they faded Ina Muller and the audience in the rapid fishing post with some of their tricks. The first -time music guest of this episode is the Berlin band Dota, which is the band project of the multi -award -winning songwriter Dota Kehr. Wilhelmsburger Shantychors de TampenTrekker, who keep the position in front of the pub windows and ensure musical intermezzi. 14 people deny the audience and surf with the beer lid questions. And everyone is well looked after by the pub host Ms. Muller - not related and conspired with Ina. Sounds slightly chaotic? Should it too! / Die Late-Night-Show mit der Entertainerin, Sangerin und Moderatorin Ina Muller, nach Mullerin Art: Talk, Comedy und viel, viel Musik in der Hamburger Kneipe Zum Schellfischposten.In dieser Sendung begruSSt Ina Muller zunachst die Schauspielerin und Buchautorin Andrea Sawatzki. Sie erzahlt von ihrer ungewohnlichen Kindheit, den Jobs, mit denen sie sich fruher uber Wasser hielt, und vom Kennenlernen ihres heutigen Mannes Christian Berkel.Zum Gesprach hinzu kommen die Ehrlich Brothers. Die Illusionskunstler berichten, wie aus ihren kleinen Anfangen eine der groSSten Zaubershows der Welt wurde, die nun auch durch die USA tourt. Und naturlich verbluffen sie Ina Muller und das Publikum im Schellfischposten mit einigen ihrer Tricks.Erster Musikgast dieser Folge ist die Berliner Band DOTA, die das Bandprojekt der vielfach ausgezeichneten Songwriterin Dota Kehr ist.Weiterer Musikgast ist Florian Paul and Die Kapelle der letzten Hoffnung, die sich virtuos zwischen Chanson, Pop und Jazz bewegen.Das gefallt auch den Herren des Wilhelmsburger Shantychors De Tampentrekker, die vor den Kneipenfenstern die Stellung halten und fur musikalische Intermezzi sorgen. 14 Personen bestreiten das Publikum und durfen mit den Bierdeckelfragen mithelfen. Und alle werden wieder bestens versorgt von der Kneipenwirtin Frau Muller - nicht verwandt und verschwagert mit Ina. Klingt leicht chaotisch? Soll es auch!

programme.title: Commissioner Laurenti / Commissario Laurenti
programme.desc: Of all things, a dramatic incident occurs during a state visit by the German Chancellor in the Italian port city of Trieste: a man, dressed only with an operating room, jumps into panic fear on the Kustenstrasse and is rolled over by an accompanying vehicle. Commissario Laurenti (Henry Hubchen) takes on the investigation in the Council - who is the unknown dead person who, according to the forensic medical findings, comes from Eastern Europe, which nobody wants to know and nobody seems to be missing? And what was he on the run? When the renowned surgeon of a luxurious protective clinic is cruelly murdered shortly afterwards, Commissario and his assistant Antonio (Florian Panzner) come to a hot track: With the help of the retired forensic doctor Galvano (Rolf Hoppe), you will find that the murdered doctor specialized in organ transplants. programme.title: Eco / Eco
programme.desc: School start - how much money do good schools need? The new school year has already started in eastern Austria. And now it becomes clear where the teacher is missing, where there are school psychologists and for what measures the school budget is not enough. The Minister of Education is pleased that his ministry does not have to save as much as other areas of the federal government. The educational budget is even increased somewhat - but the majority flows into the salaries with the staff. What do these budget requirements mean for the new school year? Austria is around 14,000 euros per schooler and school year internationally in the top field, but in the PISA test results for math or reading skills, you are only on average. But is it actually needed millions or can be achieved a lot with more efficiency or restructuring? Report: Pia Bichara, Bettina FinkWeififligen - how our bonitat is secretly rated how are we kept? Our bonitat is constantly evaluated by special companies - and hardly anyone knows about it. In addition to the KSV 1870, it is primarily the Bonitatskanzlei "CRIF" that awards so-called creditwurdability scores for private individuals. Most of them are based on "CRIF" only on age, gender and residential address, the data protection officer Max Schrems criticizes. Nevertheless, due to this few data, an evaluation sometimes decides which conditions we tolerate for cell phone, electricity or loans. Which companies rely on this data and what do we can do about it? Report: Gerhard Jansersalle Years again - why in supermarket the Christmas mood will come up with the mood in the summer, vanilla biscuits and Christstollen - which sounds like Advent market, is also a reality in midsummer. Already in mid -August there are the first Christmas sweets in the supermarket shelves. While some are happy, the others are not very enthusiastic. Because gingerbread in August polarize: for some of a early pleasure, for the others an annual annoyance. But who actually sets the tone on this early start to Christmas - the trade, the consumers or the producers? And is the whole thing just an economic calculation - or is there more behind it? Report: Ines Ottenschlager / Schulstart - wie viel Geld brauchen gute Schulen?Das neue Schuljahr hat im Osten Österreichs bereits begonnen. Und jetzt wird klar, wo heuer Lehrer fehlen, wo es genugend Schulpsychologen gibt und fur welche MaSSnahmen das Schulbudget nicht reicht. Der Bildungsminister freut sich, dass sein Ministerium heuer nicht ganz so viel sparen muss, wie andere Bereiche des Bundes. Das Bildungsbudget wird sogar etwas aufgestockt - der GroSSteil flieSSt allerdings in die Gehaltserhohungen beim Personal. Was bedeuten diese Budgetvorgaben fur das neue Schuljahr? Österreich liegt zwar mit rund 14.000 Euro Kosten je Schuler und Schuljahr international im Spitzenfeld, bei den Pisa-Testergebnissen fur Mathe- oder Lesekompetenzen liegt man allerdings nur im guten Durchschnitt. Doch braucht es tatsachlich zusatzliche Millionen oder lasst sich mit mehr Effizienz oder Umstrukturierungen auch viel erreichen? Bericht: Pia Bichara, Bettina FinkZweifelhafte Abfragen - wie unsere Bonitat heimlich bewertet wirdWie kreditwurdig sind wir? Von speziellen Unternehmen wird unsere Bonitat laufend bewertet - und kaum jemand weiSS davon. Neben dem KSV 1870 ist es vor allem die Bonitatskanzlei "CRIF", die so genannte Kreditwurdigkeits-Scores fur Privatpersonen vergibt. Meist basieren diese bei "CRIF" nur auf Alter, Geschlecht und Wohnadresse, kritisiert der Datenschutzer Max Schrems. Trotzdem entscheidet eine Bewertung aufgrund dieser wenigen Daten mitunter, zu welchen Konditionen wir Vertrage fur Handy, Strom oder Kredite bekommen. Welche Unternehmen verlassen sich auf diese Daten und was konnen wir dagegen tun? Bericht: Gerhard JanserAlle Jahre wieder - warum in Supermarkten schon im Sommer Weihnachtsstimmung aufkommtLebkuchen, Vanillekipferl und Christstollen - was nach Adventmarkt klingt, ist langst auch im Hochsommer Realitat. Bereits Mitte August gibt es in den Supermarktregalen die ersten weihnachtlichen Naschereien. Wahrend sich die einen daruber freuen, sind die anderen wenig begeistert. Denn Lebkuchen im August polarisieren: Fur die einen ein vorgezogener Festgenuss, fur die anderen ein alljahrliches Ärgernis. Doch wer gibt eigentlich den Ton an bei diesem fruhen Start in die Weihnachtszeit - der Handel, die Konsumentinnen und Konsumenten oder die Produzenten? Und ist das Ganze nur wirtschaftliches Kalkul - oder steckt mehr dahinter? Bericht: Ines Ottenschlager

Because gingerbread in August polarize: for some of a early pleasure, for the others an annual annoyance. But who actually sets the tone on this early start to Christmas - the trade, the consumers or the producers? And is the whole thing just an economic calculation - or is there more behind it? Report: Ines Ottenschlager / Schulstart - wie viel Geld brauchen gute Schulen?Das neue Schuljahr hat im Osten Österreichs bereits begonnen. Und jetzt wird klar, wo heuer Lehrer fehlen, wo es genugend Schulpsychologen gibt und fur welche MaSSnahmen das Schulbudget nicht reicht. Der Bildungsminister freut sich, dass sein Ministerium heuer nicht ganz so viel sparen muss, wie andere Bereiche des Bundes. Das Bildungsbudget wird sogar etwas aufgestockt - der GroSSteil flieSSt allerdings in die Gehaltserhohungen beim Personal. Was bedeuten diese Budgetvorgaben fur das neue Schuljahr? Österreich liegt zwar mit rund 14.000 Euro Kosten je Schuler und Schuljahr international im Spitzenfeld, bei den Pisa-Testergebnissen fur Mathe- oder Lesekompetenzen liegt man allerdings nur im guten Durchschnitt. Doch braucht es tatsachlich zusatzliche Millionen oder lasst sich mit mehr Effizienz oder Umstrukturierungen auch viel erreichen? Bericht: Pia Bichara, Bettina FinkZweifelhafte Abfragen - wie unsere Bonitat heimlich bewertet wirdWie kreditwurdig sind wir? Von speziellen Unternehmen wird unsere Bonitat laufend bewertet - und kaum jemand weiSS davon. Neben dem KSV 1870 ist es vor allem die Bonitatskanzlei "CRIF", die so genannte Kreditwurdigkeits-Scores fur Privatpersonen vergibt. Meist basieren diese bei "CRIF" nur auf Alter, Geschlecht und Wohnadresse, kritisiert der Datenschutzer Max Schrems. Trotzdem entscheidet eine Bewertung aufgrund dieser wenigen Daten mitunter, zu welchen Konditionen wir Vertrage fur Handy, Strom oder Kredite bekommen. Welche Unternehmen verlassen sich auf diese Daten und was konnen wir dagegen tun? Bericht: Gerhard JanserAlle Jahre wieder - warum in Supermarkten schon im Sommer Weihnachtsstimmung aufkommtLebkuchen, Vanillekipferl und Christstollen - was nach Adventmarkt klingt, ist langst auch im Hochsommer Realitat. Bereits Mitte August gibt es in den Supermarktregalen die ersten weihnachtlichen Naschereien. Wahrend sich die einen daruber freuen, sind die anderen wenig begeistert. Denn Lebkuchen im August polarisieren: Fur die einen ein vorgezogener Festgenuss, fur die anderen ein alljahrliches Ärgernis. Doch wer gibt eigentlich den Ton an bei diesem fruhen Start in die Weihnachtszeit - der Handel, die Konsumentinnen und Konsumenten oder die Produzenten? Und ist das Ganze nur wirtschaftliches Kalkul - oder steckt mehr dahinter? Bericht: Ines Ottenschlager

programme.title: Culture today / Kultur Heute
Land of the mountains / Land der Berge
programme.desc: While the cities grow and everyday life becomes denser, the longing of many people increases according to nature, silence and originality. The Alm is considered a romantic background - but behind the idyll there is often a hard everyday life. This new "Land of the Mountains" production embarks on an impressive journey into the Alpine World of the Salzburg country - to people who cultivate their alpine pastures with passion, perseverance and deeply rooted. On the Loseggalm and the Hoislalm you can find out from the challenges that tourism brings to the alpine pasture - where hiking trails drive through suckler cows and pretends to see new approaches to protect the willow animals. A special event is the Noriker stallion in Rauris. Here, cultural heritage becomes a social event and the Schachneralm shows how generational alpine pasture works - because it has been family -owned for over 200 years. The women are in the foreground when sheet bumbing on the Ellym in Unken. With their extensive knowledge of the healing effects of individual herbs, they contribute an important contribution to the preservation of old traditions and religious customs. / Wahrend Stadte wachsen und der Alltag dichter wird, steigt die Sehnsucht vieler Menschen nach Natur, Stille und Ursprunglichkeit. Die Alm gilt als romantischer Ruckzugsort - doch hinter der Idylle verbirgt sich oft ein harter Alltag.Diese neue "Land der Berge"-Produktion begibt sich auf eine eindrucksvolle Reise in die alpine Welt des Salzburger Landes - zu Menschen, die mit Leidenschaft, Ausdauer und tief verwurzelter Tradition ihre Almen bewirtschaften. Auf der Loseggalm und der Hoislalm erfahrt man von den Herausforderungen, die der Tourismus mit auf die Alm bringt - wo Wanderwege durch Mutterkuhherden fuhren und zuruckkehrende Raubtiere wie der Wolf neue Ansatze zum Schutz der Weidentiere fordern. Ein besonderes Ereignis ist der Noriker-Hengstauftrieb in Rauris. Hier wird kulturelles Erbe zum gesellschaftlichen Ereignis und die Schachneralm zeigt, wie generationenubergreifende Almwirtschaft funktioniert - denn sie ist bereits seit uber 200 Jahren in Familienbesitz. Beim Krauterbuschbinden auf der Ederalm in Unken stehen die Frauen im Vordergrund. Mit ihrem umfangreichen Wissen uber die heilende Wirkung einzelner Krauter tragen sie einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erhalt alter Traditionen und religiosem Brauchtum bei.

programme.title: Summer freshness in Karnten: Lake Millstatt / Sommerfrische in Karnten: Der Millstatter See
programme.desc: The location between the Nockberge biosphere park, the Hohe Tauern, the Goldeck and the Mirnock makes the Millstatter See region unique. It is a landscape full of myths and stories that harbors an ancient "treasure" with the grenade. At Karnten's deepest lake there is a mild, almost Mediterranean climate that attracted nobility and burger at the turn of the last century and a villa culture arose that does not have to shy away from comparison with the founded Wortersee architecture. With its early Middle Ages, Millstatt is not only a peace pole and habitat, but also a scene for art and culture at an international level. Even in tourism, nothing will be left out for chance: the tourist fortunes of the region are long managed by professional adventure drama who create attractions for today's demanding guest. The "on the way in Austria" is the stories and experiences of a summer in a "world of opposites" between the mountain and the lake. / Die Lage zwischen dem Biospharenpark Nockberge, den Hohen Tauern, dem Goldeck und dem Mirnock macht die Region Millstatter See einzigartig. Es ist eine Landschaft voller Mythen und Geschichten, die mit dem Granat einen uralten "Schatz" birgt. An Karntens tiefstem See herrscht ein mildes, fast mediterranes Klima, das schon um die vorletzte Jahrhundertwende Adel und Burgertum anzog und eine Villenkultur entstehen lieSS, die den Vergleich mit der beruhmten Wortherseearchitektur nicht zu scheuen braucht. Mit seinem fruhmittelalterlichen Stift ist Millstatt heute nicht nur ein Ruhepol und Lebensraum, sondern auch ein Schauplatz fur Kunst und Kultur auf internationalem Niveau. Auch im Tourismus wird nichts dem Zufall uberlassen: die touristischen Geschicke der Region werden langst von professionellen Erlebnisdramaturgen gemanagt, die Attraktionen fur den anspruchsvollen Gast von heute kreieren. Das "Unterwegs in Österreich" erzahlt die Geschichten und Erlebnisse eines Sommers in einer "Welt der Gegensatze" zwischen Berg und See.

programme.title: Land of the mountains / Land der Berge
programme.desc: This "Land of Mountains" production goes on a cinematic foray from the Salzburg High Corigal massif to Grossarl Valley. The sharp spikes of these stone majesty are reminiscent of a crown and give an idea of ​​the unimaginable forces of nature that were at work when the powerful massif. The summit of the highly king, which belongs to the mountain range of the Berchtesgaden Alps, overrides all other mountains in the nearby area with its 2,941 meters and pays to the most prominent in the Alps. On the way down, from the rock cravings of the stone sea over the split alpine landscape, the habitat for flora and fauna becomes more friendly: roaring water traps and sadgrune alpine meadows hem. The landscape of the Grossarl Valley, which is also called the "valley of the Alms". There are about forty -managed alpine huts from early year to autumn. To date, the "Sauerkas" region for the region has been produced in a traditional way: skipped by hand, kneaded with a high effort and lifted in wooden shapes. In the main town of Grossarl, the spate baroque parish church is enthroned visibly over the old stone houses of the market. With traditional folk music, culinary peculiarities and real customs, a splendid Thanksgiving festival is celebrated here. Natural filmmaker Hans Jochler draws a picture of this angle of this angle of the Salzburg mountains that is as visual and lifelong in this "Land der Bergen". / Diese "Land der Berge"-Produktion begibt sich auf einen filmischen Streifzug vom Salzburger Hochkonigsmassiv ins malerische GroSSarltal. Die scharfen Zacken dieser steinernen Majestat erinnern an eine Krone und lassen die unvorstellbaren Krafte der Natur erahnen, die bei der Entstehung des machtigen Massivs am Werk waren. Der Gipfel des Hochkonig, der zum Gebirgsstock der Berchtesgadener Alpen gehort, uberragt mit seinen 2.941 Metern alle anderen Berge im naheren Umkreis und zahlt zu den prominentesten der Alpen. Am Weg hinab, von der Felswuste des Steinernen Meeres uber die zerkluftete alpine Landschaft, wird der Lebensraum fur Flora und Fauna allmahlich freundlicher: tosende Wasserfalle und sattgrune Almwiesen saumen das Landschaftsbild des GroSSarltals, das auch das "Tal der Almen" genannt wird. Von Fruhjahr bis Herbst gibt es etwa vierzig bewirtschaftete Almhutten. Bis heute wird hier der fur die Region typische "Sauerkas" nach traditioneller Art hergestellt: Von Hand abgeschopft, mit hohem Kraftaufwand geknetet und in holzerne Formen gehoben. Im Hauptort GroSSarl thront die spatbarocke Pfarrkirche weithin sichtbar uber den alten Steinhausern des Marktes. Mit traditioneller Volksmusik, kulinarischen Besonderheiten und echtem Brauchtum wird hier jahrlich die ein prachtiges Erntedank-Fest begangen. Naturfilmer Hans Jochler zeichnet in diesem "Land der Berge" ein ebenso bildgewaltiges wie lebensnahes Bild dieses Winkels der Salzburger Bergwelt.

programme.title: Harrys liabste Huttn / Harrys liabste Huttn
programme.desc: Harry Prunster is on the trail of Via Natura, a 130 km long hiking trail and begins his hike at 1,600 meters Seehohe. Before Harry visits the Grebenzen protection house, he makes a detour to the Schonel pilgrimage church. This was built in 1828 instead of a chapel built in 1736. Protective house host Bernhard Radauer, Harry, is raising the history of the Hutte, who was built in 1988 and who has already visited Harry. Harry meets Angelika and Reinhard Ferner in the tonner hut. Both grew up on the hat and returned to their origin after studying or an apprenticeship. Uroma Ermelinda was already on the Alm as a dairy, today the tasks are precisely divided in the family business. Harry's last station is the Gasthof Leitner, and on the way there he passes the Durnberg Moor. In the Gasthof Leitner, Andreas took the management of the Hutte from his parents at the turn of the year. He is the 4th generation that runs the courtyard. During his time abroad, he even cooked for the Norwegian king. / In Grebenzen macht sich Harry Prunster auf die Spur der Via Natura, eines 130 km langen Wanderwegs und beginnt seine Wanderung auf 1.600 Metern Seehohe. Bevor Harry das Grebenzen-Schutzhaus besucht, macht er einen Abstecher zur Wallfahrtskirche Schonanger. Diese wurde 1828 anstelle einer 1736 erbauten Kapelle errichtet. Schutzhaus-Wirt Bernhard Radauer erzahlt Harry die Geschichte der Hutte, die 1988 gebaut wurde und die Harry schon einmal besucht hat. In der Tonnerhutte trifft Harry auf Angelika und Reinhard Ferner. Beide sind auf der Hutte aufgewachsen und nach einem Studium bzw. einer Lehre wieder an ihren Ursprung zuruckgekehrt. Bereits Uroma Ermelinda war als Sennerin auf der Alm, heute sind in dem Familienbetrieb die Aufgaben genau aufgeteilt. Harrys letzte Station istder Gasthof Leitner, und auf dem Weg dorthin kommt er am Durnberger Moor vorbei. Im Gasthof Leitner hat Andreas zum Jahreswechsel die Leitung der Hutte von seinen Eltern ubernommen. Er ist die 4. Generation, die den Hof betreibt. Wahrend seiner Zeit im Ausland hat er sogar fur den norwegischen Konig gekocht.

WETTER/INFO / WETTER/INFO
Country life / Landleben
programme.desc: In the otherwise tranquil Kaunertal, there is great excitement every five years, because then the large district music festival with 26 chapels takes place in the grass. There are almost more musicians in the valley than people actually live there. The marquee, the moving in the chapels, the barrel tapping, the based on the greater marching competition and the state-related reception of the guardians around their captain Franz keep the locals and visitors trot. In this "country life" production, director Christian Papke accompanies people around this unique festival. While the big music festival is celebrated down in the Kaunertal, life has its own rhythm on the top of the Alm. Matthias Schnegg is hiding his cow on Nasserein-Alm, while his sister Sarah grief for the traditional costumes of the musicians and helps prepare the music festival. At the bottom of the valley, the farmers prepare the hayers and the immudent Otto Kummerts as the way responsible for paths for the road network in the Kaunertal, while Mountain Master Joe Kase-Supplement from Nasserein-Alm. / Im sonst so beschaulichen Kaunertal herrscht alle funf Jahre groSSe Aufregung, denn dann findet in der Grasse das groSSe Bezirksmusikfest mit 26 Kapellen statt. Dabei sind fast mehr Musiker im Tal, als dort eigentlich Menschen leben. Das Festzelt, der Einzug der Kapellen, der Fassanstich, der beruhmt-beruchtigte Marschierwettbewerb und der landesubliche Empfang der Schutzen rund um ihren Hauptmann Franz halten die Einheimischen und die Besucher auf Trab. Regisseur Christian Papke begleitet in dieser "Landleben"-Produktion die Menschen rund um dieses einzigartige Fest. Wahrend unten im Kaunertal das groSSe Musikfest gefeiert wird, hat das Leben oben auf der Alm seinen eigenen Rhythmus. Matthias Schnegg hutet auf der Nasserein-Alm seine Kuhe, wahrend seine Schwester Sarah sich um die Trachten der Musikanten kummert und bei der Vorbereitung des Musikfests hilft. Unten im Tal bereiten die Bauerinnen die Heuernte vor und der unermudliche Otto kummert sich als Wege-Verantwortlicher um das StraSSennetz im Kaunertal, wahrend Bergmeister Joe Kase-Nachschub von der Nasserein-Alm besorgt.

Sie verwenden Werkzeuge, haben eine Sprache und entwickeln manchmal sogar eine eigene Kultur.Lange Zeit haben Psychologen und Biologen die Fragen nach dem tierischen Bewusstsein auSSerhalb der seriosen Forschung verortet. Man konnte schlichtweg nicht in den Kopf des Tieres hineinschauen. Kognitionsbiologen wie Ludwig Huber sind sich sicher, dass es im Tierreich wahre Intelligenzbestien gibt. Philosophinnen wie Anne Sophie Meincke sehen daher die Grenze zwischen den Menschen und dem Tierreich immer mehr verschwimmen. Das hat nicht nur Folgen fur die Tierhaltung. Auch in der Frage der Personenrechte musste ein Umdenken stattfinden.Die Universitat Wien hat vor einigen Jahren eine Forschungsstation fur Raben eingerichtet. Denn Raben zahlen zu den intelligentesten Tieren auf diesem Planeten: Sie benutzen nicht nur Werkzeuge, sondern bauen sie sich auch selbst. Die Vogel konnen vorausschauend in die Zukunft planen und sich in Artgenossen hineinversetzen. Sie sind sich uber sich selbst bewusst und beherrschen einfache Mathematik. Und vor allem: sie sprechen! Thomas Bugnyar ist sich sicher: "Es gibt gezielte Rufe fur gefundenes Futter. Es gibt ferner gezielte Laute fur mogliche Feinde. Aber auch die Sprache untereinander ist sehr differenziert. Wir sind uns sicher, dass Raben und Krahen mitunter die komplexeste verbale Kommunikation nach dem Menschen besitzen."Fur die Intelligenzforscher sind vor allem Tiere interessant, die in sozialen Gruppen miteinander leben. Denn die Entwicklung der Intelligenz, wie wir sie kennen, hat viel mit dem kommunikativen Verhalten im Rudel zu tun. Soziale und kognitive Intelligenz sind entwicklungsgeschichtlich miteinander verbunden. Deshalb forscht Friederike Range an Wolfen und Hunden. Sie hat ein Experiment entwickelt, in dem die Tiere an einem Seil ziehen mussen, um zu ihrer Belohnung zu kommen. Allerdings ist es dabei notwendig, miteinander zu kooperieren. "Wir haben herausgefunden, dass Wolfe bei diesem Experiment sehr gut miteinander kooperieren und miteinander die Aufgaben losen. Hunde aber brauchen den Menschen vielmehr als Ideengeber. Der Hund kann dafur sehr gut verstehen, was der Mensch von ihm erwartet."Viel ahnlicher als Wolf und Hund sind uns aber die Menschenaffen. Zwischen ihnen und dem Menschen gibt es auch biologisch nicht allzu viele Unterschiede. Der Leipziger Biologe Christophe Boesch entdeckte im afrikanischen Urwald eine Bonobo-Population, die zum Nusseknacken Steine verwendet. Ware das nicht schon besonders genug kommt noch hinzu, dass in diesem Wald kaum Steine zu finden sind. Die Affen mussen also ihr Werkzeug woanders suchen, beschlieSSen, dass der Stein tauglich ist und ihn in die Nahe der Nusse schaffen.Auch unsere Nutztiere sind alles andere als stumpfsinnig. Schweine konnen die Gesichter ihrer Bezugspersonen zweifelsfrei zuordnen und leben in komplexen sozialen Strukturen. Wenn sich der Mensch tatsachlich von den Tieren abheben mochte, muss er bald sein Verhalten ihnen gegenuber andern.Eine Dokumentation von Florian Kroppel und Kurt Langbein

programme.title: Almsommer / Almsommer
programme.desc: A dairy in Styria, a Schafbauer in East Tyrol and a shepherd in Vorarlberg give an insight into a life that is characterized by the protective of the landscape and a traditional culture. It is not only the spectacular cattle business on the Lechtaler-Almen, in which 450 cattle overlook a 2500-meter-high saddle, but also the recovery of the alpine pastures. The Hutten of the Oberstallalm in East Tyrol are very popular with the holidaymakers, although there is no "almanimateur" there, but only a wood oven, flow water and fresh milk. The film by Maria Magdalena Koller shows life on the home alpine pastures, one of the splendid scenes in Austria's mountains. / Eine Sennerin in der Steiermark, ein Schafbauer in Osttirol und ein Hirte in Vorarlberg geben Einblick in ein Leben, das von der Schonheit der Landschaft und von einer traditionsreichen Kultur gepragt ist. Beeindruckend ist dabei nicht nur der spektakulare Viehtrieb auf die Lechtaler-Almen, bei denen 450 Rinder einen 2500 Meter hohen Sattel uberqueren, sondern auch die wieder gewonnene Wertschatzung der Almen als Urlaubsort. Die Hutten der Oberstalleralm in Osttirol sind bei den Urlaubern sehr beliebt, obwohl es dort keinen "Almanimateur" gibt, sondern nur einen Holzofen, FlieSSwasser und frische Milch.Der Film von Maria Magdalena Koller zeigt das Leben auf den heimischen Almen, eine der prachtigsten Kulissen in Österreichs Bergwelt.

programme.title: Land of the mountains / Land der Berge
programme.desc: This "Land of Mountains" production goes on a cinematic foray from the Salzburg High Corigal massif to Grossarl Valley. The sharp spikes of these stone majesty are reminiscent of a crown and give an idea of ​​the unimaginable forces of nature that were at work when the powerful massif. The summit of the highly king, which belongs to the mountain range of the Berchtesgaden Alps, overrides all other mountains in the nearby area with its 2,941 meters and pays to the most prominent in the Alps. On the way down, from the rock cravings of the stone sea over the split alpine landscape, the habitat for flora and fauna becomes more friendly: roaring water traps and sadgrune alpine meadows hem. The landscape of the Grossarl Valley, which is also called the "valley of the Alms". There are about forty -managed alpine huts from early year to autumn. To date, the "Sauerkas" region for the region has been produced in a traditional way: skipped by hand, kneaded with a high effort and lifted in wooden shapes. In the main town of Grossarl, the spate baroque parish church is enthroned visibly over the old stone houses of the market. With traditional folk music, culinary peculiarities and real customs, a splendid Thanksgiving festival is celebrated here. Natural filmmaker Hans Jochler draws a picture of this angle of this angle of the Salzburg mountains that is as visual and lifelong in this "Land der Bergen". / Diese "Land der Berge"-Produktion begibt sich auf einen filmischen Streifzug vom Salzburger Hochkonigsmassiv ins malerische GroSSarltal. Die scharfen Zacken dieser steinernen Majestat erinnern an eine Krone und lassen die unvorstellbaren Krafte der Natur erahnen, die bei der Entstehung des machtigen Massivs am Werk waren. Der Gipfel des Hochkonig, der zum Gebirgsstock der Berchtesgadener Alpen gehort, uberragt mit seinen 2.941 Metern alle anderen Berge im naheren Umkreis und zahlt zu den prominentesten der Alpen. Am Weg hinab, von der Felswuste des Steinernen Meeres uber die zerkluftete alpine Landschaft, wird der Lebensraum fur Flora und Fauna allmahlich freundlicher: tosende Wasserfalle und sattgrune Almwiesen saumen das Landschaftsbild des GroSSarltals, das auch das "Tal der Almen" genannt wird. Von Fruhjahr bis Herbst gibt es etwa vierzig bewirtschaftete Almhutten. Bis heute wird hier der fur die Region typische "Sauerkas" nach traditioneller Art hergestellt: Von Hand abgeschopft, mit hohem Kraftaufwand geknetet und in holzerne Formen gehoben. Im Hauptort GroSSarl thront die spatbarocke Pfarrkirche weithin sichtbar uber den alten Steinhausern des Marktes. Mit traditioneller Volksmusik, kulinarischen Besonderheiten und echtem Brauchtum wird hier jahrlich die ein prachtiges Erntedank-Fest begangen. Naturfilmer Hans Jochler zeichnet in diesem "Land der Berge" ein ebenso bildgewaltiges wie lebensnahes Bild dieses Winkels der Salzburger Bergwelt.

programme.title: Traun - a river like a crystal / Traun - Ein Fluss wie ein Kristall
programme.desc: The Traun is the central axis of a diverse water system: thunderous glacier briefing, water trap, numerous lakes, sources of all kinds, hollow water, silent lowland meadows, thousands of kilometers of stream and river walking - all of this feeds a single river. This variety is barely tangible - and still letters: from an exhilaration, the look at a clear day is grasped at a clear day Whole long of the river, from the wild, strictly protected Traunauen in the Linz urban area to the Dachstein. So the wild path of water from the Dachstein to the Danube became the earning strand. This was intertwined with a second: the path of the river through the seasons. And then with a third: the path of the Traun through a millennium of their moving history. A film by Erich Proll and Klaus Feichtenberger / Die Traun ist die zentrale Achse eines vielfaltigen Gewassersystems: Tosende Gletscherbache, Wasserfalle, zahlreiche Seen, Quellen aller Art, Hohlengewasser, stille Tieflandauen, Tausende Kilometer von Bach- und Flusslaufen - all das speist am Ende einen einzigen Fluss.Diese Vielfalt ist kaum fassbar - und dennoch buchstablich uberschaubar: Von einer Anhohe nordlich der Donau erfasst der Blick an einem klaren Tag die ganze Lange des Flusses, von den wilden, streng geschutzten Traunauen im Linzer Stadtgebiet bis zum Dachstein. So wurde der wilde Weg des Wassers vom Dachstein zur Donau zum Erzahlstrang. Dieser wurde mit einem zweiten verflochten: dem Weg des Flusses durch die Jahreszeiten. Und dann mit einem dritten: dem Weg der Traun durch ein Jahrtausend ihrer bewegten Geschichte.Ein Film von Erich Proll und Klaus Feichtenberger

programme.title: Country life / Landleben
programme.desc: The Traunviertel, which can come up with scenic protecting such as the Hollengebirge, the Traunsee or the Gosautal, to the cheapest spots in the Salzkammergut. Gestalter Wolfgang Winkler hat sich fur diese Landleben-Neuproduktion in der Region umgesehen und mehrere Originale bei ihrem Alltag begleitet: etwa Goldhaubenfrauen und Hammerherren bei einer Kutschenfahrt mit Michael Hofstatter durch die Landschaft des Traunviertels, den Jager Hans Schmidhuber bei einem Spaziergang durch den Wald, die Krauterfrau Rita Lackinger bei einem Rundgang durch die sommerliche Blumenwiese oder im Handwerksmuseum mit Peter Kerbl, der allerlei alte Schatze zeigt, von alten Bauernhandwerken bis hin zu einer historischen Holzturensammlung.

programme.desc: As is well known, opposites attract; So also in Vorarlberg. Because if you are traveling around Bludenz with the mountain bike, you not only experience a region full of variety, but also meet a very special human beat. Funf Taler, four stages, 178 kilometers and a proud 5,300 high meters-in this "Land of the Mountains" production, everything revolves around the Vorarlberg Alpine region on two raders. The first stop is still a real high point: the Lunersee is at the foot of the Schesaplana massif in the Ratikon and is considered one of the barnest lakes in the Alps. The visit to the Brandnertal, in the first bike park in Vorarlberg, is somewhat more daring. Here, courageous cycling enthusiasts expand their skill - so can be used to try out high springs, the driving over strong traps and over gnarled root network. The next stage goes into the big Walsertal; An excursion to the biosphere park there, past colorful, light-luminous carpets and crystal-clear waters, is also an extraordinary pleasure on the bike. Redy treats attract the last section of the tour, the destination of which is in the Montafon. In the middle of the fascinating mountains can be found here an managed alpe, on which more than thirty cows spend their summer freshness. At 1,730 meters of Seehohe, the fresh milk is processed directly into butter and the typical Montafoner Sauerkase there. Producer Toni Silberberger Ladt is on a varied journey between adventures and unforgettable moments, which runs through the Brandnertal, the Walgau, the Klostertal, the Montafon and the Biosphalepark Grosses Walsertal. / Gegensatze ziehen sich bekanntlich an; so auch in Vorarlberg. Denn wer rund um Bludenz mit dem Mountainbike unterwegs ist, erlebt nicht nur eine Region voller Abwechslung, sondern trifft ebenso auf einen ganz besonderen Menschenschlag. Funf Taler, vier Etappen, 178 Kilometer und stolze 5.300 Hohenmeter - in dieser "Land der Berge"-Produktion dreht sich alles um die Erkundung der Alpenregion Vorarlberg auf zwei Radern.Bereits der erste Halt offenbart einen wahren Hohepunkt: Der Lunersee liegt am FuSSe des Schesaplana-Massivs im Ratikon und gilt als einer der schonsten Seen der Alpen. Etwas waghalsiger gestaltet sich der Besuch im Brandnertal, im ersten Bikepark Vorarlbergs. Hier erweitern mutige Radsport-Begeisterte ihre Geschicklichkeit - so konnen hohe Sprunge, das Fahren uber starke Gefalle und uber knorrige Wurzelgeflechte erprobt werden. Die nachste Etappe fuhrt in das GroSSe Walsertal; ein Ausflug in den dortigen Biospharenpark, vorbei an bunt-leuchtenden Blutenteppichen und kristallklaren Gewassern, ist auch auf dem Rad ein auSSerordentlicher Genuss. Wurzige Leckerbissen locken zum letzten Abschnitt der Tour, deren Ziel im Montafon liegt. Mitten in der faszinierenden Bergwelt ist hier eine bewirtschaftete Alpe zu finden, auf der mehr als dreiSSig Kuhe ihre Sommerfrische verbringen. Auf 1.730 Metern Seehohe wird die frische Milch in der dortigen Kaserei direkt zu Butter und dem typischen Montafoner Sauerkase verarbeitet.Der Produzent Toni Silberberger ladt auf eine abwechslungsreiche Reise zwischen Abenteuern und unvergesslichen Momenten ein, die durch das Brandnertal, den Walgau, das Klostertal, das Montafon und den Biospharenpark GroSSes Walsertal fuhrt.

programme.title: Land of the mountains / Land der Berge
programme.desc: Vorarlberg's impressive alpine landscapes are the focus of this "Land of Mountains" new production. From the jointly cultivated pram in front of the foreman in the Bregenzerwald over the picturesque Batzen Alpe on Lake Korbersee to the Sporaalpe in Tschagguns, which is known for its special Sauerkase - every alpine pasture has its own history and characteristics. The documentation illuminates the life of the Älpler, the muzzful everyday life of the dairies and the close connection between humans, animals and nature. The Alpe Erles Finne in Egg, which is managed by a family with its own cattle, also shows how alpineering is still operated with heart and devotion today. In Vorarlberg, over 500 Alps are managed, on which around 40,000 animals spend the summer every year. The alpine economy is an essential part of regional agriculture and makes a significant contribution to maintaining and maintaining the alpine cultural landscape. This production is a homage to the protective and originality of the Alps and offers fascinating insights into a world that was characterized by generations. / Vorarlbergs beeindruckende Almlandschaften stehen im Mittelpunkt dieser "Land der Berge"-Neuproduktion. Von der gemeinschaftlich bewirtschafteten VorsaSS Vorderhopfreben im Bregenzerwald uber die malerische Batzen Alpe am Korbersee bis hin zur Sporaalpe in Tschagguns, die fur ihren besonderen Sauerkase bekannt ist - jede Alm hat ihre eigene Geschichte und Charakteristik. Die Dokumentation beleuchtet das Leben der Älpler, den muhevollen Alltag der Sennereien und die enge Verbindung zwischen Mensch, Tier und Natur. Auch die Alpe Erles Finne in Egg, die von einer Familie mit eigenem Vieh bewirtschaftet wird, zeigt, wie Almbewirtschaftung heute noch mit Herz und Hingabe betrieben wird. In Vorarlberg werden uber 500 Alpen bewirtschaftet, auf denen jahrlich rund 40.000 Tiere den Sommer verbringen. Die Alpwirtschaft ist ein essenzieller Bestandteil der regionalen Landwirtschaft und tragt maSSgeblich zur Pflege und Erhaltung der alpinen Kulturlandschaft bei. Diese Produktion ist eine Hommage an die Schonheit und Ursprunglichkeit der Alpen und bietet faszinierende Einblicke in eine Welt, die von Generationen gepragt wurde.

programme.desc: Audience favorite Harald Krassnitzer did it and is on one of the ten most beautiful long-distance hiking trails in the world for this "Land of the Mountains" production: the Alpe-Adria Trail. Mountains, lakes, trusted towns. Flusse and forest. And finally the sea. 750 kilometers across breathtaking landscapes in 2x45 minutes. Coming from Karnten Harald Krassnitzer overrun in the second part more than just a border: starting at the Easter Reichisch-Slovenian Grenzuge, he walks Talwarts to Kranjska Gora. The Alpe-Adria Trail is a Grenn-to-do joint project of Karnten, Slovenia and Friuli-Julisch-Venetien in northeastern Italy. The path partly runs along the historical paths, along the Soca River, Italian Isonzo, which was a little more than 100 years ago the scene of some of the cruelest battles of the First World War. Even today, the landscape is drawn by the events at that time, but today people are no longer looking for the boundary stones from back then, but only the signposts of the long -distance hiking trail to find the right path towards Trieste to the sea, which is often recognizable in the distance through the haze. / Publikumsliebling Harald Krassnitzer hat es getan und ist fur diese "Land der Berge" Produktion unterwegs auf einem der zehn schonsten Weitwanderwege der Welt: Dem Alpe-Adria-Trail. Der Alpe-Adria-Trail ist ein grenzuberschreitendes Gemeinschaftsprojekt von Karnten, Slowenien und Friaul-Julisch-Venetien im Nordosten Italiens. Der Weg fuhrt teils uber historische Pfade, entlang des Flusses Soca, italienisch Isonzo, der vor etwas mehr als 100 Jahren Schauplatz einiger der grausamsten Schlachten des Ersten Weltkriegs war. programme.title: Fate days of Austria / Schicksalstage Österreichs
programme.desc: In the new episode of "Austria's" Fate Days ", ORF III is devoted to one of the most drastic moments of young history. The documentation of Judith Doppler reconstructs the dramatic days in early September 2015 when tens of thousands of escape lodges came to Austria - and political, moral and logistical systems reached their limits. A few days earlier, the disadvantage of Parndorf had shown with more than 70 dead that the migration movement and its supporting modes had arrived in the heart of Europe. At the center of the documentation are the crisis management of Federal Chancellor Werner Faymann and the diplomatic negotiations with Viktor Orban, Angela Merkel and EU Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker. Today's Lower Easter General Governor Johanna Mikl-Leitner remembers the tensions inside the government. Christian Kern, Sebastian Kurz and Michael Haupl describe their view of the political and human challenges of these weeks. Journalist Rainer Nowak and author Susanne Scholl classify the events in the larger European context. The film also shows the other side of this state of emergency: the spontaneous willingness to help. At the Vienna Central Station, "Train of Hope" is created with an initiative that quickly becomes a symbol. Take over thousands of volunteers that state structures cannot cope with. In interviews with representatives of various aid organizations, as well as talking with refugees, the documentation also illuminates the human aspects of these dramatic weeks. From October 2015, the focus is relocated to playing field in Styria. Pictures of chaotic scenes are the public perception - and cause the mood in the country. The discussion about a fence along Austria's borders leads to the word of the year "structural measure", but also illustrates how torn the country is now in the question of migration policy. Spaded with the striking of Paris in November 2015, the debate changed sustainably. What was decided within a few weeks at the time has been re -effect on today - and a decade also asks the question of how Europe wants to deal with flight, security and integration. / In der neuen Folge von "Schicksalstage Österreichs" widmet sich ORF III einem der einschneidendsten Momente der jungeren Geschichte. Die Dokumentation von Judith Doppler rekonstruiert die dramatischen Tage Anfang September 2015, als zehntausende Fluchtlinge uber Ungarn nach Österreich gelangten - und politische, moralische wie logistische Systeme an ihre Grenzen stieSSen.Schon wenige Tage zuvor hatte das Ungluck von Parndorf mit mehr als 70 Toten gezeigt, dass die Migrationsbewegung und ihre Tragodien im Herzen Europas angekommen waren. Im Zentrum der Dokumentation stehen das Krisenmanagement von Bundeskanzler Werner Faymann und die diplomatischen Verhandlungen mit Viktor Orban, Angela Merkel und EU-Kommissionsprasident Jean-Claude Juncker.Wahrend die Dublin-Regelung de facto auSSer Kraft gesetzt wird, ringt Europa um eine gemeinsame Linie - unter dem Druck von Bildern, die um die Welt gehen. Die heutige niederosterreichische Landeshauptfrau Johanna Mikl-Leitner erinnert sich an die Spannungen im Inneren der Regierung. Christian Kern, Sebastian Kurz und Michael Haupl schildern ihre Sicht auf die politischen und menschlichen Herausforderungen dieser Wochen. Journalist Rainer Nowak und Autorin Susanne Scholl ordnen die Ereignisse im groSSeren europaischen Kontext ein.Der Film zeigt aber auch die andere Seite dieses Ausnahmezustands: die spontane Hilfsbereitschaft. Am Wiener Hauptbahnhof entsteht mit "Train of Hope" eine Initiative, die rasch zum Symbol wird. Tausende Freiwillige ubernehmen, was staatliche Strukturen nicht bewaltigen konnen. In Interviews mit Vertreterinnen und Vertretern verschiedener Hilfsorganisationen, sowie Gesprachen mit gefluchteten Personen, beleuchtet die Dokumentation auch die menschlichen Aspekte dieser dramatischen Wochen.Ab Oktober 2015 verlagert sich der Brennpunkt nach Spielfeld in der Steiermark. Bilder von chaotischen Szenen pragen die offentliche Wahrnehmung - und verandern die Stimmung im Land. Die Diskussion uber einen Zaun entlang Österreichs Grenzen fuhrt zum Unwort des Jahres "Bauliche MaSSnahme", verdeutlicht aber auch, wie zerrissen das Land mittlerweile in der Frage der Migrationspolitik ist. Spatestens mit den Anschlagen von Paris im November 2015 verandert sich die Debatte dann nachhaltig.Was damals innerhalb weniger Wochen entschieden wurde, wirkt bis heute nach - und stellt auch ein Jahrzehnt spater noch die Frage, wie Europa mit Flucht, Sicherheit und Integration umgehen will.
